definitions.explanation: A mechanical device that moves air, used for ventilation, cooling, drying, or industrial processes. Refers to dedicated blower units rather than household fans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送風機|そうふうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Large blowers are installed in the factory.

examples.japanese: {送風機|そうふうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}して→回す：01158_mawasu⟧⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}えた→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧。
examples.english: I ran the ventilation fan to circulate the indoor air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{送風機|そうふうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: After painting work, it's necessary to dry thoroughly using a blower.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{送風|そうふう}→送風：23691_soufuu⟧ (sending air/ventilation) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). A technical term for dedicated air-moving equipment, distinct from household electric fans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{送風機|そうふうき}: large blower
- {工業用|こうぎょうよう}{送風機|そうふうき}: industrial blower
- {送風機|そうふうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to run a blower
- ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧{送風機|そうふうき}: ventilation fan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{扇風機|せんぷうき}→扇風機：05069_senpuuki⟧: electric fan — household fan for personal cooling
- ⟦{換気扇|かんきせん}→換気扇：04678_kankisen⟧: ventilation fan — typically installed in walls or ceilings of kitchens and bathrooms
- サーキュレーター: circulator fan — for circulating room air, often used with air conditioning
- ⟦{空調|くうちょう}→空調：27362_kuuchou⟧: air conditioning — broader climate control system
